set_aside.subject: build_budget_view
set_aside.text: - build_budget_view: [VALIDATION_ERROR] When the project has no active budget version, or a supplied version_id resolves to no version of this project, MUST raise ScopedNotFoundError after closing the read transaction, because BudgetView.version_id is a required identity and absence cannot be returned as a view. It MUST NOT raise RegistryBoundaryError, which belongs to the registry boundary and carries a required failure kind, and it MUST NOT fabricate an empty view with zero totals.
set_aside.question: The requirement mandates raising ScopedNotFoundError, but after removal of its __init__ contract the prompt gives only the imported class name and no valid constructor signature; must the zero-argument constructor contract be restored, or should the requirement specify how the exception is instantiated?
set_aside.set_aside_because: an unchanged passage of a unit reviewed for its change
